mode: Terminal recorded-clock policy comparison; no untouched holdout claim

syntheticCheck.description: Controlled five-share two-leg scenario with later trade-throughs; establishes behavior, not market profitability.

constraints: No new hedge-buy submission; only existing funded opposite quotes can be retained.
Total original opposite buys plus covered-sale pledges must not exceed owned shares plus the optional declared residual-share cap.
Worst owned basis plus both per-share fees and opposite quote price must leave minimumEdge.
Partial-entry hedges beyond the declared residual cap, gaps, silence and explicit drains still cancel. Already canceled quotes are never reinstated.
Fully filled quotes are excluded from active cancellation only when the optional policy is enabled.

partialPacketScenario.basis: Controlled test only; residual covered sale incurs a loss and no profitability is inferred.

limitations: Replay changed one cancellation but no realized profit in the completed ten-share episode.
Residual exposure is directional and its loss can erase the paired gain.
Synthetic scenarios establish controlled behavior only.
